_comment: Metric catalog in ID order (MET-001..040). formula null means the definition exists but no agreed formula was ever documented (L6 trap). Sources are mart table names.

metrics.name: Units Sold
metrics.definition: Number of new and used vehicles invoiced to customers in the period.

metrics.name: Gross Margin %
metrics.definition: Share of net revenue left after cost of sales, across vehicles, parts and service.

metrics.name: Average Order Value
metrics.definition: Average net revenue of a parts order placed by dealers and trade customers.

metrics.name: Average Transaction Price
metrics.definition: Average price customers actually paid for a vehicle after discounts.

metrics.name: Discount Rate
metrics.definition: Average discount given on a vehicle as a share of its list price.

metrics.name: Lead Conversion Rate
metrics.definition: Share of sales leads that turn into a signed vehicle order.

metrics.name: Pipeline Value
metrics.definition: Expected value of all open sales opportunities that have not been won or lost.

metrics.name: Win Rate
metrics.definition: Share of closed opportunities that were won.

metrics.name: Test Drive Conversion
metrics.definition: Share of leads with a completed test drive that go on to buy.

metrics.name: Market Share
metrics.definition: Northwind Motors registrations as a share of all registrations in a region.

metrics.name: Sales Target Attainment
metrics.definition: Units sold as a share of the budgeted unit target for the period.

metrics.name: Service Retention Rate
metrics.definition: Share of vehicle owners who return to the dealer network for scheduled servicing within the expected interval.

metrics.name: First Time Fix Rate
metrics.definition: Share of repairs that did not need a repeat visit for the same fault.

metrics.name: Revenue per Repair Order
metrics.definition: Average labour and parts revenue on a workshop repair order.

metrics.name: Workshop Utilization
metrics.definition: Technician hours sold as a share of the standard hours available.

metrics.name: Warranty Claim Rate
metrics.definition: Warranty claims per thousand vehicles sold.

metrics.name: Warranty Cost per Unit
metrics.definition: Approved warranty cost net of supplier recovery, per vehicle in the fleet.

metrics.name: Recall Completion Rate
metrics.definition: Share of vehicles affected by a recall that have had the fix applied.

metrics.name: Customer Satisfaction Score
metrics.definition: Average satisfaction score customers give after a sale or service visit.

metrics.name: Net Promoter Score
metrics.definition: Promoters minus detractors as a share of survey respondents.

metrics.name: Average Repair Time
metrics.definition: Average labour hours booked on a repair order.

metrics.name: Parts Fill Rate
metrics.definition: Share of parts order lines shipped complete from stock on the first pick.

metrics.name: Parts Margin %
metrics.definition: Parts revenue minus parts cost of sales, as a share of parts revenue.

metrics.name: Inventory Turnover
metrics.definition: How many times the average parts stock is sold through in a year.

metrics.name: Days of Supply
metrics.definition: Number of days current stock would last at the recent average daily demand.
metrics.formula: SUM(fct_inventory_snapshot.on_hand_qty) / AVG(daily shipped quantity over the last 90 days)

metrics.name: On-Time Delivery
metrics.definition: Share of shipments delivered to the dealer by the promised date.

metrics.name: Backorder Rate
metrics.definition: Share of parts order lines that could not be shipped because stock was missing.

metrics.name: Supplier Lead Time
metrics.definition: Average number of days between placing a purchase order and receiving the goods.

metrics.name: Return Rate
metrics.definition: Returned parts quantity as a share of parts shipped.

metrics.name: Aged Stock Share
metrics.definition: Share of stock value held for more than 90 days.

metrics.name: Revenue Growth YoY
metrics.definition: Change in revenue compared with the same period of the previous year.
metrics.formula: SUM(revenue_amount this period) / SUM(revenue_amount same period last year) - 1, from fct_gl_margin

metrics.name: Operating Expense Ratio
metrics.definition: Operating expenses as a share of revenue.

metrics.name: Budget Variance
metrics.definition: Difference between actual spend or revenue and the approved budget for the period.

metrics.name: Revenue MTD
metrics.definition: Revenue booked from the first day of the current month up to yesterday.
metrics.formula: SUM(fct_gl_margin.revenue_amount) WHERE dim_date.calendar_date BETWEEN month_start AND yesterday

metrics.name: Dealer Profitability Index
metrics.definition: Composite index ranking dealers by profitability after incentives and support costs.

metrics.name: Days Sales Outstanding
metrics.definition: Average number of days it takes customers to pay their invoices.
metrics.formula: AVG(days between invoice date and payment date) weighted by invoice amount, from fct_gl_margin receivables lines

metrics.name: Cost per Lead
metrics.definition: Marketing spend divided by the number of leads it generated.

metrics.name: Return on Ad Spend
metrics.definition: Revenue attributed to paid media for every unit of currency spent.

metrics.name: Website Conversion Rate
metrics.definition: Share of website sessions that end with an enquiry or test drive form.

metrics.name: Customer Lifetime Value
metrics.definition: Expected total margin from a customer across vehicle purchases and service visits.
